rows.en: Charge!
rows.notes: Transcript 'tochi no seigyo' is garbled; MUF reads totsugeki (charge), which fits the slot and length.

rows.en: Begin close combat!
Enough. Stand back.
You, fall back!
Stay away from the enemy.
Crush them!
rows.notes: Transcript 'hineri subu ze'; most plausibly hineri-tsubuse (crush them), an order to the partner like the other pilots' 172 lines. MUF English read it as 'I'll crush you!'; either fits.

rows.en: All-out attack authorized.
All-out attack, begin!
I won't allow this!
rows.notes: Transcript 'iyerusamu' is nonsense; same sounds as MUF's yurusanu (I won't allow it).

rows.en: No more holding back.
rows.notes: Transcript 'te ga herasen'; surely tekagen wa sen (no more holding back), as MUF.

rows.en: On the pride of the Zentradi!
Understood.
Very well.
rows.notes: Transcript 'yuroshisu' is a mishearing of yoroshii (very well), as MUF.

rows.en: Hm, hm, hm... So be it, so be it.
rows.notes: AF transcript repeats yokarou twice where MUF has it once; kept the repeat, though it could be a Whisper echo.

rows.en: What's the matter, Captain?
rows.notes: Transcript 'dou shita tachi wo' is garbled; most likely dou shita, taichou (what's wrong, Captain), as MUF.

rows.en: Further damage is dangerous!
Can you still move, Captain?
Haah... What a disaster!
rows.notes: Slot 184 is the captain going down; Britai's dismay at that. AF adds a sigh.

rows.en: Impossible... To think the captain was shot down...
rows.notes: No subject in the Japanese. Slot 185 is the captain (leader) being shot down for every pilot, so 'the captain' is restored; MUF English had just 'Shot down...'.

rows.en: Useless.
rows.notes: Slot 186 reacts to the captain being shot down; yaku ni tatanu has no subject and the bare 'Useless.' keeps that, aimed at the downed captain.

rows.en: Protoculture...
What is this feeling? We're leaving!
rows.notes: Iku zo read as 'we're going (home)': slot 188 is a song-induced withdrawal line for every pilot. MUF English had 'Let's go!', which reads as advancing.

rows.en: So this is Culture... We're withdrawing.
rows.notes: AF transcript bunka (Culture) is right; MUF transcript misheard it.

rows.en: All you need to do is follow my orders.
Take this to heart: I won't tolerate reckless moves.
Don't hinder me with needless meddling.
You will support me.
Watch how I fight.
Battle is about to begin. Don't let your guard down!
We can't afford to fail this operation. We're going out too!
Let us show them our full strength!
Live up to my expectations.
I leave it to you!
I'm entrusting this operation to you!
Let's go! We should have no problem together!
You did well to make it back.
Your duty is done. Let's head back at once.
Enough.
I expect you to handle at least this much.
rows.notes: AF transcript says konashite (handle) where MUF heard tobashite (fly); translated the AF reading.

rows.en: Good. You did well.
Mission accomplished. We're returning.
I never expected you to achieve results this great.
As I thought, you never betray my trust.
Keep up the good work as my right hand.
You show promise!
Your skill is reassuring.
You performed beyond my expectations.
Somehow, I can't trust women.
rows.notes: Transcript ends shinyou dekiru (can trust), which contradicts doumo; surely shinyou dekinu (can't trust), as MUF.

rows.en: Why must I fight alongside you?
Just concentrate on staying out of my way.
rows.notes: Transcript 'sonnen shimasu' is a mishearing of sennen (concentrate); Britai would not use -masu here. Read as an order, as MUF.

rows.en: This operation absolutely cannot fail.
Follow my orders and there'll be no problem.
The operation's starting. Focus.
You, take the support role!
I'm expecting great things from you.
Show me everything you've got!
W-W-What is this? This feeling I have toward you...
rows.notes: AF stutters three times and trails off where MUF ends with '!'.

rows.en: With you here, the operation's success is assured!
Perhaps I'll follow you for once.
To think you were the only one who could sortie.
rows.notes: Transcript has a garbled tail (to wa nai to); read as to wa na, as MUF.

rows.en: What on earth were you doing?
I'll ask you not to get in the way anymore.
rows.notes: AF says moraitai where MUF heard moraou ka; same meaning.

rows.en: You seem to be safe.
I'm counting on you next time too.
You carried out the operation without a hitch.
I've seen plenty of your skill.
rows.notes: Transcript demae (food delivery) is a mishearing of udemae (skill).

rows.en: Your fighting is rather pleasing!
I never thought you'd be this good!
I'm beginning to feel Culture myself.
To think I'd feel joy fighting alongside you!
Who are you?!
Ngh... is this as far as I go?
rows.notes: Transcript 'koko made iku' is garbled; most likely koko made ka (is this as far as I go), as MUF.

rows.en: Did you think you could defeat me?
Oops, I hit 'em!
rows.notes: AF line differs from MUF (a, yabe): naguchimatta, 'I went and hit (them)'. Slot 010 is an attack line, so Basara reluctantly landing a hit fits; object unstated, kept neutral 'em.

rows.en: Melee Beauty!
rows.notes: AF line differs from MUF (nigasanu): kakutou-bi, with hi heard for bi. Same term as Gavil's 167 'Melee Beauty!'.

rows.en: Strike Beauty!
rows.notes: AF line differs from MUF (massatsu-bi): transcript dageki-hei, most likely dageki-bi (strike beauty).

rows.en: You Protodeviln clinging to Gamlin, get out!
rows.notes: Same line as MUF; Gamlin-san rendered as plain 'Gamlin' as in her other lines.

rows.en: I'll be serving as your bridge operator. Pleased to work with you.
rows.notes: Shared with MUF; existing English kept.

rows.en: I'm your bridge operator. Nice to meet you.
rows.notes: Shared with MUF; existing English kept.

rows.en: I'll be your bridge operator. Let's work well together.
rows.notes: Shared with MUF; existing English kept.
